contract: workspace.history.upsert.write / write / upsert(path, now): plain {path,last_used_at,use_count}; one increment and supplied timestamp; row read joins the same immediate transaction; default-clock upsert(path) remains supported; failures roll back and unknown outcomes are never automatically replayed.
sharedPlumbing: Unchanged native gateway adapter, SQLite binding/transaction implementation and Date.now default clock are reused.
mcpBoundary: Public workspace.add and all MCP refresh/import/tool-default dependencies are outside this construction command. No claim that their full graph has been measured or audited here.
